_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 50: 19-24 February 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was generational sex abuse and things buried in the Vatican that they did not want out, that he saw it was generational and bad and that it would eventually come out, and recalls the Lord telling him to remember something.
mentions.quote: things that were buried in the Vatican that they did not want out
mentions.falsify_match: Further disclosures of historic abuse in the Catholic church.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Decades of such disclosures already exist, so a match requires nothing new.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying they will see things with the church and big churches, that he saw churches in California, TV stations, and mega ministers who would be on the platform and would be no more because they would have to resign.
mentions.quote: I saw mega ministers that would be on the platform and would be no more
mentions.falsify_match: Named ministers resigning and broadcasters closing.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Resign is more specific than the earlier shaking language, which is a real tightening.

mentions.claim_text: He says judgment begins in the house of the Lord first and that because of this God will also clean the world, with the manifestations starting to be seen in 2026, and points to reports of three million Epstein list photos and Bill Gates and others.
mentions.quote: I will also clean the world, and you'll start to see the manifestations in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Major disclosures during 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is pointing at disclosures already in the news as the fulfilment.

mentions.claim_text: He says he wants to go from glory to glory and be just like Jesus, asks whether that makes sense and helps, says they all have things they are going through, and asks whether they want to play the rest of the word.
mentions.quote: I want to go from glory to glory. I want to be just like him
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw him coming against Claudia, that things would start to happen and America would be involved in this concerning Rubio, and that a shaking was going to take place in Mexico, noting he gave these words back at the first of the year in January.
mentions.quote: I saw America be involved in this concerning Rubio. a shaking in Mexico
mentions.falsify_match: American pressure on the Mexican president with the Secretary of State involved. The January telling is inside this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such confrontation. Shaking is undefined as usual.

mentions.claim_text: They try to date a previous video, settle on December something, and discuss the thumbnail and the Chinese channel.
mentions.quote: I think it was December something. December something
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and another instance of the dates being reconstructed on air rather than recalled.

mentions.claim_text: He says it looks beautiful on the lawn and is something to be seen, that he saw it in the vision, that he saw the negotiations of the third temple, and that he saw the groundwork starting to be done.
mentions.quote: I saw the negotiations of the third temple
mentions.falsify_match: Negotiations or groundwork toward a third temple.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. No date is attached, which is what keeps it from coming due.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that they are strong and have a backbone, and cites that men's hearts will fail them for fear as they look at the things coming on the earth and at all this change.
mentions.quote: man's hearts will fail them for fear
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a scriptural description of the last days used to interpret the present.

mentions.claim_text: He says he finds it interesting given what was said over the last couple of days, that if they go back to what the Lord showed them in the last video he will go over some of the visions and what was shown in prayer, and that it lined up.
mentions.quote: it lined up with
mentions.falsify_match: The previous video is in this corpus, so the lining up can be checked directly.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what will come out of this and what will keep transpiring with Brad Garlinghouse's meetings that he saw, where the banks were on one side of a table and the crypto people on the other and they came to an agreement.
mentions.quote: the banks were on one side and crypto people were on the other
mentions.falsify_match: A banking and crypto industry settlement involving the named executive.

mentions.claim_text: He says that is what is happening, a thousand companies so far, that this is what he saw a little while ago, that this is all about the elections and November is coming, and says there it is, do they see it.
mentions.quote: A thousand companies so far. This is all about the elections
mentions.falsify_match: A thousand companies doing whatever is meant, ahead of the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: The number is countable but what they are doing is not stated in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He is asked where the expectation comes from and says you can never predict exactly how the Senate and Congress will go, then says that in February of last year he said they are going to make a bill and make it all, and begins on what Trump does.
mentions.quote: you can never predict exactly how Senate and Congress is going to
mentions.falsify_match: The February 2025 telling is inside this corpus and can be read against this recall.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not say what he says it says. Worth noting the concession: he says legislative outcomes cannot be predicted exactly.

mentions.claim_text: The co-host says he has to pay attention to the prediction markets, that they should talk about that, and that the prediction markets around the Clarity Act spiked at that point.
mentions.quote: the prediction markets around the Clarity Act spiked
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: someone else reporting market data.

mentions.claim_text: He says they shook hands on it and the Lord said this will birth the beast system, that it is all happening, that this is how they have a digital dollar, and that it all comes out of it in order to put the chip in your hand or on your forehead.
mentions.quote: The Lord said, This will birth the beast system
mentions.falsify_match: A digital currency framework leading to mandatory identification.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is calling the same crypto settlement he has prayed for the birth of the beast system, which is worth recording plainly.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know when it will all come about, that they are saying March 1st and he did not know, that he does not watch the news because Braden brings it to him, and that much more is required of him by the Father.
mentions.quote: They're saying March 1st, I didn't know. I don't watch the news
mentions.falsify_match: The date comes from the news rather than from a sight, and he says so.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Recorded because it shows a reported date entering the material from outside.

mentions.claim_text: He gives thanks for the body that was broken, says that on February 21st it is neat, and thanks God for his timing and for how he tells them things in advance of what is coming.
mentions.quote: How you tell us things in advance of what's coming
mentions.falsify_match: The advance notice claim, which is what this database exists to test.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that he has a president who is on fire for God, allows that he may not be all that right now or as on fire as he would want, but says he is going to be radical for Jesus, tongue talking and Holy Ghost filled.
mentions.quote: he's going to be radical for Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: A public charismatic conversion by the president.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not happen. Unusually specific for a declaration: it names speaking in tongues.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they see the spotted gecko, says he sees its eye and that it is licking its eye, repeats that he sees the gecko, and names a suit, a nose and part of the ladder they sell at Walmart.
mentions.quote: A spotted gecko licking his eye. And a suit. And a nose
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a list of images with no interpretation offered.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees April big before him, that it is a month, that the A in April is big and highlighted with black on the outside, and that the capital A is emboldened, black with something like a slide on the side.
mentions.quote: I see April big before me. The A in April is big
mentions.falsify_match: Something notable in April 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet April. No content is attached to the month, only its typography, though black elsewhere in the corpus signals darkness.

mentions.claim_text: He says the vision moves in a particular way and that he can see July, August and September moving around like looking at a clock, and that he can see going into 2027.
mentions.quote: this represents almost like you're looking at a clock
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is another account of how the dates are arrived at: months arranged on a dial he reads round.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything changes, that he sees it tonight around the same timeframe talking about the third temple, that they are going to construct it and build this thing, and that he can see them starting to build.
mentions.quote: they're going to construct it. They're going to build this thing
mentions.falsify_match: Construction beginning on a third temple by 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: No construction. This is the first time the temple claim carries a window.

mentions.claim_text: He says the visions he is describing tonight are very bold, very bright and very colourful and quite amazing, and mentions again that the ballroom is absolutely beautiful.
mentions.quote: they're very bold, they're very bright and they're very colorful
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, but by his own key the brightness means these are urgent.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is always highlighted to him and answers how he knows it is 2028, because the vision says 2028, that it is huge and has a wall, that it is in black letters, and that he goes up to it and cannot get over it.
mentions.quote: It's in black letters 2028 and I can't get over it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a wall at 2028 that he cannot see past is an absence of sight, not a claim about the world.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they uploaded what the Lord specifically said and whether they have the version without the girl talking, and they agree to prepare it.
mentions.quote: Did you upload that? without the girl talking
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: production talk about clipping an original recording.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something like gangrene, saying that when gangrene sets in through blood sugar problems they amputate, and that this is what he saw happening in a man's genitalia with so much infection that they had to amputate.
mentions.quote: this is what I saw happening in a man's genitalia
mentions.falsify_match: A newly reported infection causing tissue loss.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Second telling of the disease-as-judgment claim, now with a mechanism borrowed from diabetic complications.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether people see Jesus in them, whether they are salty or have lost their saltiness when they go into a store or a place, and whether the cares of the world have choked the life out of them.
mentions.quote: Have you lost your saltiness
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He refers to the pressure on him being such that he was sweating drops of blood, says this is different but it is pressure on the flesh, and begins to describe being the roadblock, the tree in the road.
mentions.quote: this is different but it's pressure on the flesh
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an account of what carrying this costs him.

mentions.claim_text: He prays against every plot against their churches during Easter, says he sees this right now during Easter, calls it a new one and tells them to take note, that he sees plots against their Easter services, and mentions Ramadan starting.
mentions.quote: I see plots against our Easter services
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on a church at Easter 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. He flags it himself as new, which is worth having: he distinguishes fresh material from repeats.

mentions.claim_text: He asks which path the Lord wants him to go down because every one of them had something, says he has seen so many different little paths, and that when he is praying he sees a road with each one branching.
mentions.quote: what path do you want me to go down?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a plain account of how much is seen and how little is chosen for saying.
